subject: S23-G: how do authors record YouTube mappings in a pack?
body: The brief says authors map videos with the S20 mapper, but the pack schema (naadi_api/seed/packs.py) has no videos file, and the mapper needs YOUTUBE_API_KEY + a DB (video_candidates). Is the plan (a) the hosted weekly youtube_map cron proposes candidates per section after the seed and admins approve, so authors do nothing in the pack, or (b) a pack-level videos.json (sectionId -> videoId, start/end) you'll add in phase 2? If (b), give me the shape and I'll fill it, checking embeddability via oEmbed (reachable here). Until then I'll write sections only.
